svg.title: 04 · Analyzer
svg.desc: The user's analyzer board: the frontend sends a question to the KPI gate, which answers with a preset query when one fits; otherwise the Claim Query Agent, fed by its example bank, cached references and prompts, writes CLI calls with SQL that pass the SQL guard to the DuckDB query service, which reads only this customer's semantic layer.

g.text: Preset fixed SQL · The agent fills in parameters to the preset queries
would it fail? stop it here
no keyless joins > 100 M row pairs

svg.text: FAILS A CHECK: ERROR TO THE AGENT
The Claim Query Agent is the run worker. The DuckDB query service holds the credentials.
AGENT WRITES CLI CALLS WITH SQL
Claim Query Agent · run worker on Fargate
